basis: One exhaustive independent read of every numbered outline act, every customer-life step, every published-example journey step, the served vendored spec/doc examples and their patches, all authored pack semantics/manifest, and architecture Writing a life, What a judge rejects and Published examples. No authored content was edited by this judge.

rulings.rule: Published examples: nothing asserted that the vendor generates or defaults
rulings.required: In steps[6], remove the value-pinned expectations for omitted text, bcc, cc, reply_to and scheduled_at; name these paths in undecided with the reason that their null/empty representation is the vendor's omitted-field default rather than a value this setup supplied. Keep the assertions for sent/captured fields, the setup-caused creation date and delivered state, and submitted tags. Do not replace these with guessed default values.

rulings.rule: Published examples: nothing asserted that the vendor generates or defaults
rulings.required: In steps[8], [9] and [19], remove value-pinned assertions for the default region and capabilities created by the name-only request; explain those paths in undecided as vendor defaults. In steps[9], also remove the pinned false open_tracking and click_tracking defaults and explain them in undecided. Keep initial/verification status as the effect of the setup, captured ids and DKIM, name and creation-date assertions, and at steps[19] keep the open/click tracking values actually set by steps[10]. The Create/Get reference samples show open_tracking true while this setup pins false; a published sample and unspecified default must not be converted into an author-chosen constant.

rulings.rule: Published examples: a setup makes the example's precondition true; every exampleDiffers reason must not excuse a twin defect; content must bear out the named act
rulings.required: Change steps[23] into an incoming message that carries real attachment bytes for the Retrieve Received Email and List Received Emails examples. Include at least a valid inline PNG with a content id and a valid PDF document, with filename/content type/disposition metadata and sizes derived from their bytes, so the retrieve example's attachment shape is exercised rather than erased. Supply a real Received header whose for clause names forwarded@example.com (or the equivalent outside envelope observation from that header), since the vendored GetReceivedEmailResponse defines received_for from Received headers, not from to. Preserve the existing sender, recipients, subject, HTML and authentication facts. Its setup name must describe the attached incoming fixture.

rulings.rule: Published examples: decided values asserted; reasons must not excuse twin defects; vendor behaviour cannot contradict the spec
rulings.required: In steps[24] and [25], change names to describe the attached fixture, remove the attachments exampleDiffers explanations and empty-attachment expectations, and assert the attachment metadata caused by steps[23] (filenames, MIME types, dispositions/content id where supplied, byte-derived sizes and collection membership/count). Capture generated attachment ids from the actual response when needed; do not guess them. Assert received_for in steps[24] as derived from the new Received/header observation. Retain existing sent/captured body, header, date and authentication assertions. In steps[24], remove value-pinned expectations for omitted text, html_format and raw.expires_at and explain those paths in undecided: these are generated/default representations, and the example sample alone does not make a particular expiry or format a setup-decided value. In steps[25], remove pinned default empty bcc/cc/reply_to arrays and explain them in undecided, unless the new incoming fixture explicitly supplies those values. Any remaining exampleDiffers must describe an actual documented fixture difference, not missing implementation support.

rulings.rule: What a judge rejects: content must bear out the step's name; Published examples: a setup reads an example's actual effect
rulings.required: In steps[26], still download the captured raw URL without a key, but also assert that the raw MIME retains the submitted HTML body and the actual attachment bytes/parts introduced by steps[23], including their filenames and appropriate MIME types/encodings. Header-only subject matching cannot prove that the downloaded raw message is the incoming message: the current renderer emits text/plain with an empty body for this HTML-only fixture. Assertions may compare submitted bytes in their actual MIME transfer encoding; never substitute fabricated metadata or guessed content.

doubts: steps[9] explains records[].priority by unordered domain records. Both vendored Create/Get samples establish that priority belongs to MX and not DKIM; the order explanation is supported, and it is not rejected.
steps[7] preserves the published batch request and explains the distinct documented testing-domain refusal under this account owner. It is not rejected.
review: Read all steps[0] through [28], all 12 served published operation examples, their response schemas and patches, setup/effect chains, default/generated values, collection assertions and every exampleDiffers reason. Only the steps named in the rulings require authored journey changes; all other steps retain their content.
